criteria.text: The bug, feature and small-change skills let my agent merge a pdd PR only after my explicit chat request and green checks, first recording my exact request in a PR comment.
The merge uses `gh pr merge` with `--merge --match-head-commit <head>`; absent request, failed or pending checks, a changed head or a failed request comment cannot merge.

Help, docs and skills describe --said, the one-step gate/prompt approval, preserved terminal/native-chat routes and root pdd.json strict_approvals, while the agent never changes expected values on its own.
The workflow start command is `pdd workflow run`; other 0.1.12 command names and the rule that pdd itself never merges stay unchanged.

cases.given: stub gh, explicit person request, exact current head, all checks green
cases.required_observation: comment exact safely quoted request first; gh pr merge --merge --match-head-commit HEAD afterwards

cases.given: no explicit request; separately pending/failing checks, changed head, comment failure
cases.required_observation: zero merge calls; no pdd merge command; builder never merges real PR

cases.given: review docs/skills/help/caps/byte-identical RUNBOOK copies using native suite
cases.required_observation: all named files describe exact said/default/strict/one-step/native routes; expected-value and no-hand-edit rules remain

cases.given: parse/run/help/completion workflow run feature 2755; test old check/try notices and view/Interpreter/simulate words
cases.required_observation: run canonical and notice-free; existing workflow start remains former-name compatibility; all other 0.1.12 names unchanged
